title: Two novel Zr-rich refractory high-entropy alloys with excellent tensile mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting using raw materials with purity greater than 99.95 wt% in a high purity argon atmosphere. The alloys were melted six times to ensure the chemical homogeneity and then suction casted into a bar with a size of φ20 mm × 300 mm.
